notes.title: Announcement of Version 1.9 Update for Metal Slug: Awakening
notes.notes: [p]Dear Commander,[/p][p]Mech Troops Rise! Rally at Ice Pole! Brand new version, with a plethora of exciting content waiting for you to explore![/p][p]We are scheduled for a maintenance update from 14:00 to 20:00 (UTC - 5) on June 9th. Once the update is complete, you will receive New Version Invitation *1 (redeemable only once for Sapphires *500) when logging into the game.[/p][p]Gameplay Updates and Optimizations[/p][p]1. New Gameplay: Phantasmic Geocenter[/p][p]Brand-new PVE gameplay, vast map, and a thrilling mowing experience! In the Phantasmic Geocenter gameplay, you can:[/p][p]- Carry the brand - new combat unit - Source Energy Mech, explore in randomly generated large - scale map levels, enjoy exciting battles, eliminate enemy soldiers to accumulate energy, and defeat the final boss.[/p][p]- Obtain generous rewards: Legendary - quality Laser Gun, Mythic Weapon Fragments, Season - exclusive Solution Chip, and a large number of other rewards.[/p][p]2. New Joint Operation - Abyss[/p][p]- New mechanism levels "Slate Sealing Spirit" and "Melting Ice" are officially available.[/p][p]- Gameplay Reward Upgrade: In the Joint Operation - Abyss gameplay, the ranking rewards in the Abyss Polar Mode have been upgraded to selectable fragments of classic legendary weapons.[/p][p]- Friendly reminder: After the S4 version update, Double Empowerment Cards will be recycled along with other S3 Season items. Each Double Empowerment Card will be refunded with 88 Rubies.[/p][p]3. New Core[/p][p]- Tetsuyuki Core 4-piece Set: After causing explosive damage, your own damage is increased.[/p][p]Mars Root Core 4-Piece Set: After causing damage at close range, your own damage is increased.[/p][p]- Raging Science Core 4-Piece Set: After causing damage at far distance range, your own damage is increased.[/p][p]- Missile Library Core 4-Piece Set: When hitting or killing multiple enemy units, gain an attack power boost and generate bombs.[/p][p]4. New Main Story: New adventure, set off immediately[/p][p]New Adventure Stages Unlocked: Robotic Soldiers Emerge, Journey to the Ice Pinnacle. Unleash the Crisis of the Ice Source and Fight for Survival![/p][p]5. Update about Arcade Carnival[/p][p] - Wrecking Yard/Core Express/Djinn of Wealth unlocks new area Parking No. 8/Station/Altar[/p][p] - The Raid Voucher drop rate for Maze Challenge has been adjusted: Now you can claim 1 voucher for every 2 completions.[/p][p]6. Stage rewards raised[/p][p]The first-clearance rewards of coins and Military Card for S4 World Adventure levels have been raised.[/p][p]7. Season Benefits[/p][p]- After the new season starts, commanders can complete mission challenges in the Season Kick-off event mission[/p][p] to obtain the legendary quality Laser Gun - Sunwheel Scale and a large number of rewards.[/p][p]- The Season Kick-off event lasts for 30 days and contains 7 mission challenges. One mission challenge will be unlocked each day after the season starts.[/p][p]8. Other Optimizations & Updates:​​[/p][p]- Reduced​ the Sapphire cost for ​Resource Recovery​ in select game modes.[/p][p]- Adjusted​ monster difficulty in ​Hot Pursuit​ (now easier).[/p][p]- Research Workshop​ level cap increased to ​1000.[/p][p]- Weapon Display Stand: 4th slot unlocked when Commanders reach ​Lv. 150.[/p][p]- Season Mark – Hall of Glory added ​​a new Regular Display.[/p][p]New Resource[/p][p]1. \[Brand-new Rare Character- Freyja, June 10th - June 16th][/p][p]The energetic girl "Freyja" will appear in the character special dig on June 10th. Let's embrace the baptism of the cat punch![/p][p]2. \[Brand-new Rare Character- Mai Shiranui, June 10th - June 16th][/p][p]Collaboration Character Mai Shiranui Debuts! Starting from June 10th, you can obtain this hero through the character special dig and the Active Event "Feast of Butterflies".[/p][p]3. \[The brand-new weapon Plasma Cannon, June 10th - June 16th][/p][p]The brand-new weapon with severe injury abnormal attributes - Plasma Cannon will be available in the Weapon Special on June 10th. Let's look forward to the explosive damage it brings![/p][p]4. New Combat Unit Source Energy Mech[/p][p]Robotic Soldiers Emerge to Reinforce the Battlefield! Experience Season 4's All-New Combat with the Energy Core Mech![/p][p]- The Source Energy Mech will provide 2 style abilities, each of which has a basic support skill and a powerful summoning skill.[/p][p]- The Source Energy Mech has a rich Solution Chip Transformation Function. Collecting different solution chips in Season 4 can strengthen the abilities of different styles of the Source Energy Mech.[/p][p]New Event[/p][p]1. "Feast of Butterflies" from June 10th to June 30th[/p][p]Commanders can claim the powerful character Mai Shiranui for free in the event exchange store, along with special items such as the Alloy Pickaxes and Sapphires.[/p][p]2. New weapon "Power Plasma Cannon" from June 10th to June 26th[/p][p]In the new season, there is a new mechanism firearm Charging Plasma Cannon. Get it for free by participating in the event![/p][p]3. "New Season Sign-in" from June 8th to June 30th[/p][p]Sign-in for 7 days to get gifts[/p][p]Log in to the game for Father's Day on June 15th, to get special gifts.[/p][p]4. New Challenge Phantasmic Geocenter from June 10th to June 30th[/p][p]During the event, participating in the new gameplay "Phantasmic Geocenter" gives you a chance to obtain gameplay - exclusive resources to help you clear the stage.[/p][p]5. Shiranui Performance, from June 10th to June 30th[/p][p]During the event, completing the specified tasks will allow you to obtain exclusive accessories for Mai Shiranui and a high quality core.[/p][p]6. Support Pass Update - Tactical Maid launches on June 16th[/p][p]The limited outfit "Tactical Maid" is newly added to the Support Pass. You can obtain it by upgrading to the max level![/p][p]7. New Airdrop Card launches on June 10th[/p][p]Purchase the Airdrop Card to unlock the exclusive buff for the new season gameplay - Phantasmic Geocenter, helping you enjoy a smooth gaming experience.[/p][p]8. Awakening of the Mech - Crimson Steel Warhammer: Niel launches on June 21st[/p][p]Starting from June 21st, commanders can use Wish Vouchers to draw in the store. Purchase the Mech Awakening, and obtain the corresponding vehicle for free in subsequent versions.[/p]

notes.title: Metal Slug: Awakening Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Commander,

"Soaring Skies, Thunderous Changes" The new version arrives with exciting features and gameplay, ready for you to challenge!
We are scheduled for a maintenance update on 2024.02.10 14:00 - 20:00 (UTC-5). Once the update is complete, you will receive New Version Invitation *1 (redeemable only once for Sapphires *500) when logging into the game. 
In the new S3 season, commanders will be able to experience updated gameplay and explore the Sky City alongside Ame, the princess of a mysterious kingdom! What exactly does this update have in store? Join Rumi to find out!

New Gameplay
[New Abyssal Rift]
Time: 2025.02.11
1. New map "Sky City" - The Floating Riftland
2. New Season Skill unlocked - Atmospheric Barrier. Employ the barrier to face the new "climate attacks" challenges, granting your squad substantial buffs. As you encounter different harsh weather conditions in each zone, remember to use the "Atmospheric Barrier" for effective defense!

[Master Weapon Fragment Exchange]
Time: 2025.02.11
The weapon system in the S3 season introduces a new exchange feature. You can access the Weapon Star Up-Exchange interface to trade Master Weapon Fragments of the corresponding quality for existing weapon fragments to facilitate weapon star upgrades. Tip: The S3 Season Store will offer some Master Weapon Fragments for commanders to exchange.

[New Joint Operation - Abyss]
Time: 2025.02.11
In the S3 season's Joint Operation - Abyss gameplay, commanders will venture to the Sky City, soaring high above the earth, to begin a brand-new adventure! The island's protective barrier has shattered, resulting in frequent extreme weather. 
Commanders can utilize the Empyreal Wings to absorb the meteorological energy from the extreme weather, charging up weather machinery to destroy enemy battleships and fortresses.

[Abyssal Cruise]
Time: 2025.02.17
1. Two new companions are on board, each bringing a new Expertise Style!  
2. Encounter new enemies, mechanics, and stages for a fresh set of challenges;  
3. Daily quiz added—correct answers provide all-day buffs.

[New Core Parts]
Time: 2025.02.11
S3 Season introduces new Core Parts - equip them to explore endless possibilities:
- Gaea Tower Core
Ideal for characters with WOUND weapons, offering maximum DMG bonuses when using character skills. Repeated skill use can refresh the buff duration.
- Dybbuk Manifestation Core
Suited for characters with WEAK weapons, granting a Summons DMG bonus with each summon generated, enabling summons to deal significant damage.
- Amadeus Core
Perfect for characters with FREEZE weapons. To maximize benefits, commanders need to focus on increasing CRIT rate to quickly gain the Core's advantages.
- Unyielding Warrior Core
Best for characters with IGNITE weapons, where flexible movement or aerial combat abilities will maximize this Core's potential.

[Joyful Treasure Basin]
Time: 2025.02.11
Treasure Basin, grab ingots! The "Treasure Basin" event is now open. Join the challenges during this period and collect ingots for a chance to receive Powerball Fragments, Epic Gears, Limited Titles, Alloy Pickaxes, Ruby Pickaxes, Legendary Weapon Fragments, and other exciting prizes.

[Season Settlement and Reward Exchange]
1. Season Settlement: With the season update, it's time for reward settlement! Based on your performance in the S2 season, rewards for Season Mark and The Merit Leaderboard will be settled, and your Abyss Score will be converted into Abyss Coins. Log in to the game to claim your S2 season settlement rewards.
2. Season Exchange: The S2 season Ultimate Exchange is open for a limited time. Use your Abyss Coins to exchange for items, including character-exclusive Gem Rewards, Mythic Weapon Fallen Star Fragments, and other ultra-rare items.

[Growth Acceleration]
With the start of the new season, lower-level commanders will experience accelerated growth:
1. Earn additional resources when participating in activities that provide item resources.
2. Icons of item resources with growth acceleration will have an acceleration mark; click them to view the current acceleration rate.


[Level Boost]
Time: 2025.02.11
Concerned about lagging behind due to your current level? Don't worry! The S3 season presents a new growth system that lets you "instantly boost your level to quickly catch up with the main pack"! Kick off the season perfectly and easily tackle the new space adventure challenges!
1. When the server's highest level is 130, players below level 122 will be boosted to level 122.
2. When the server's highest level is 125, players below level 117 will be boosted to level 117.


[Warzone Regroup]
Time: 2025.02.11
The new S3 season, Warzone Regroup, is coming soon! We aim to enhance the competitive gaming experience for commanders in the new season by grouping several servers into a single warzone based on criteria such as commanders' combat power, server launch dates, and active player counts. For more details, please check the official community content.

New Content
[New Character - Ame]
New Rare Quality in S3 Season
Time: 2025.02.11 - 2025.02.17
Available from: Character Special Treasure Dig
Princess of the Armer Kingdom, the queen of aerial combat! The first character with flight capabilities, gaining a shield and immunity to most control effects while flying. Fire in tandem with weapons and unleash area bombardments after charging.

[New Weapon - Chakram Launcher]
Time: 2025.02.11 - 2025.02.17
Available from: Weapon Special, Weapon Treasure Dig
Using blades as tongues of fire, the infinite chakrams dominate the battlefield. This weapon represents the perfect fusion of cold and hot weaponry, utilizing a modern firearm propulsion system to launch circular blades. The high-temperature blades cause deep burns that are hard to heal.

[New Character - Alessio Limited-time UP]
Time: 2025.02.14 - 2025.02.20
Alessio, once a nobody from the outer city of Navenia, unexpectedly accepted a mission from the legendary "Captain Red Hawk" in a moment of crisis. Donning a mask, he became a hero. A hero should be seen and respected by the world!

[Lilith’s New Outfit - Fish Dragon Dance]
Time: 2025.02.18 - 2025.02.24
Available from: Djinn Wish
As an inheritor of the "Fenghua Dragon Cloth" intangible cultural heritage, her overall attire reflects the unique charm of the dragon dance culture.

[New Vehicle - Raynor]
Time: 2025.02.22 - 2025.03.01
Available from: Blind Box
The new vehicle, Towering Raynor, is coming soon. The powerful Towering Raynor is sure to help commanders overtake competitors on sharp turns and support your Metal Slug adventure!

New Events
Repair Navenia to Get Alessio
Time: 2025.02.09 - 2025.02.26
Commanders are tasked with helping Alessio complete repair missions. By completing missions like the Alessio Trial Stage and watching Alessio's video, you can earn Repair Points. These points can be exchanged for Alessio's Token *50, as well as a variety of valuable in-game rewards!

Rare Weapon - Flameborne Chainblade Rifle available for FREE
Time: 2025.02.11 - 2025.02.26
Log in cumulatively to receive fantastic rewards such as the new version's weapon - Rare quality Flameborne Chainblade Rifle Fragments (which can be exchanged for a complete rare quality Chainblade Rifle), and Maze Raid Vouchers.

Chocolate Battle
Time:  2025.02.11 - 2025.02.26
Commanders can obtain chocolates by completing the stages. These chocolates can be used in a gacha for a chance to win Scarlett's Token, Sapphires, Raid Vouchers, and other generous rewards!

Joyful Treasure Basin
Time: 2025.02.11 - 2025.02.17
Participate the event to earn exciting rewards like Sapphire Surprise Bags and Legendary Coupons. Don't wait—begin your Treasure Hoard challenge now!

Get Snow Prep Field for FREE
Time: 2025.02.15 - 2025.02.26
With spring plum blossoms stirring and chilly frosty nights behind us, a new preparation field is arriving to support commanders on their adventures in the new year! Join the event and light up Snowflakes to obtain the Snow Prep Field!

notes.title: Metal Slug: Awakening Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Metal Slug Mission Start!

Dear commanders, we will be carrying out a server maintenance on October 21st at 14:00-20:00 (UTC-5). During this period, the server will be temporarily closed. In order to ensure that the gaming experience of all commanders is not affected, please make  preparations in advance to avoid any unnecessary losses.
After the maintenance is completed, we will offer compensation to each commander including 500 Sapphires, 88,888 coins, and 50 Military Card IV.

Below are the detailed contents of this update, please read carefully.

1. New Gameplay - Treasure Cave: In this season's Abyssal Rift, commanders will venture into a new rift zone where the ocean and land coexist. In this dangerous yet treasure-filled area, embark on a new journey alongside your clubmates!
2. Gameplay Upgrade - Joint Operation Abyss Mode: In the new season of Joint Operation - Abyss Mode, commanders will head to the newly introduced Morden Army Base. The Curse Demon has taken control of Morden Army's soldiers and armor, and the curse is spreading rapidly. Unlock new mysterious powers to help break the curse and defeat your enemies.
3. New System - Growth Boosting: Growth Boosting allows commanders who are falling behind to earn more development resources by participating in daily gameplays. Additionally, level boosts are available to help those lagging behind catch up to the average level of the main group.
4. New Weapon - Laser Gun: Combining stable firepower with the potential for an energy explosion, the Laser Gun is the epitome of destructive force. High-pressure pulses surge within the energy core, the gun is always ready to wreak havoc!
5. New Character - Eiserner: Although Eiserner was just an ordinary girl with no military training not long ago, her remarkable strategic abilities quickly elevated her to become Blackfire's youngest senior commander. Striving for victory with "minimal cost," Eiserner gives the command: Attack!

notes.title: Metal Slug: Awakening Official Release FAQ
notes.notes:
Dear Commanders, the official release for Metal Slug: Awakening will be available on July 17th at 19:00(UTC-5)！
Are you all eager to start a new adventure?
Here is a FAQ we prepared for you. Please read it carefully for any common questions you may have!
 
Official Release Time:
 July 17th at 19:00 (UTC-5)
 
Download and Install
Q: When can I download and start playing Metal Slug: Awakening?
A: Metal Slug: Awakening is available for download on App Store, Google Play, Windows (Official Website) and Steam on July 18, 2024!
👉 Download here:
https://msaw.haoplay.com/mdl 

Q: What are the system requirements for downloading and installing Metal Slug: Awakening?
A: To ensure a better gaming experience, we have listed the recommended and minimum system requirements for all the commanders.

1) System requirements for Android
●Recommended Requirements:
OS: Android 8.0 or higher
CPU: Snapdragon 778G, MediaTek Dimensity 1000+, Kirin 990 or higher

●Minimum Configuration:
OS: Android 6.0 or higher
CPU: Snapdragon 439/MediaTek MT6765/Kirin 655 or higher

●Requirements for RAM and storage space:
①The Android system requires a minimum of 3GB of RAM to ensure optimal game performance;
②The game package size exceeds 2GB, and the installation and download process requires decompression, necessitating a reservation of 10GB of space;
③After the installation and decompression are completed, the extra space will be freed up. Therefore, commanders must ensure there is sufficient storage space on the device to complete the download.

2) System requirements for PC
●Recommended System Requirements:
OS: Windows 10/Windows 11, 64-bit
CPU: Intel Core i5-10400 or higher
RAM: 16GB
GPU: NVIDIA GeForce GTX1060 with 6GB or higher
Version of DirectX: 11
PC Storage: Over 30GB of available storage space on your PC

●Minimum System Requirements:
OS: Windows7 SP1/Windows8.1/Windows10/Windows 11, 64-bit
CPU: Intel Core i3-8100 or equivalent processor
RAM: 8GB RAM
GPU: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750
Version of DirectX: 11
PC Storage: Over 30GB of available storage space on your PC

Q: What should I do if I can't enter the game after launching it?
A: Please check if your phone has enough space. Make sure you have at least 10GB of space available. Also, check if you have granted network permissions to the game in your phone settings. Enabling these permissions should resolve the issue.

Q: What can I do if the game installation fails? What if the game update fails and it's stuck on loading?
A: In response to the issue of the game not being able to install or run properly, We have  already prepared a solution:
1) The game installation has failed, please check:
①Dear Commanders, please verify if the installation package on each platform is the one for this time. If not, please download the correct package for installation. Also, check if your phone has enough storage space. If not, you can try to clear some space and restart your phone for reinstallation. If you encounter any issues with package parsing, you can delete the game package, restart your phone, and download the correct package for reinstallation.
2) Failure in game update: stuck in loading, please refer to:
① Please check if your internet connection is working properly. If you still can't Login even with a good connection, you can find the Support feature on the Login page and reach out to Support for Feedback.

⭐Server and Account⭐
Q: Can commanders on the mobile and PC play together?
A: Whether you're on the mobile platform or on a PC or on the Steam, as long as you're in the same region in game, you can play together.

Q: Is there cross-platform compatibility between Android and iOS?
A: The current round of testing is only available on Android and PC. The iOS platform is not open yet, we appreciate your understanding! If there are any plans to open up the iOS platform in the future, we will announce it on our official social media. Stay tuned!

Q: How many servers will be live when the test starts
A: For this test, only one group of servers will be open. Keep in mind, it's first come, first served for registration. If the server you choose is shown as full, it means you've missed out on this testing opportunity. So, Commander, please hurry up and download the game and register your account!

⭐Server Launch Issues & Game Bug Reporting⭐
Q: What should I do if I can't login or keep getting disconnected when the game server is launched?
A: If you encounter the aforementioned issues during the game launch, commanders, please be patient. The project team is on standby at all times. Meanwhile, to ensure game stability and a good experience, commanders can also stay tuned to official community information or in-game mail messages. Any such issues will be promptly communicated once they arise.

Q: What should I do if I encounter a bug in the game?
A:In the game, commanders can click on [Settings]-[General]-[Support] to find the customer service entrance and report your issue. The team will locate and resolve the problem based on your information. Commanders can also provide feedback outside the game:
Visit the official Community: You can report bugs in the community. We will regularly review suggestions and feedback, carefully considering every valuable opinion.

Q: Where can I seek further assistance if I have more questions about game?
A: If you have any other questions, feel free to provide feedback and inquiries through official customer service. You can also provide feedback in the official community. Thank you, commanders, for your attention and support for Metal Slug: Awakening.
